_layer: STATIC — applies to every product, every brand. Change only by studio decision.

lighting.rule: STRICTLY SOFT. Large diffused source (softbox or overcast window light). No hard light, no direct sun, no specular hot spots, no harsh or hard-edged shadows.
lighting.key_direction: soft side light from upper-left at ~45 degrees
lighting.fill: white bounce opposite the key; shadow side stays open and detailed
lighting.shadow: soft, feathered contact shadow directly under the product; fades out within a short distance
lighting.exposure: even, bright but not blown; product highlights keep texture
lighting.white_balance: neutral daylight ~5200-5600K; warm/cool mood comes from the set, never from tinting the product
lighting.allowed_variation_by_mood: intensity and key/fill ratio only (bright-airy 1.5:1 up to moody-luxe 3:1); softness never changes

composition.attention_split: 70/30 — ~70% of visual attention on the product, ~30% on props and set
composition.placement: centred for hero; centre or rule-of-thirds power point for the other shots
composition.negative_space_pct: 15-25, kept clean on one side for social text overlay (not on hero)
composition.focus: product is the sharpest element; props softer or with shallow depth of field
composition.hierarchy: product has the highest local contrast and brightness; props muted and in a supporting palette
composition.prop_count: odd numbers: 0 on hero, 3 or 5 elsewhere, never more than 5 distinct props
composition.leading_lines: edges, prop direction and shadows point toward the product
composition.scale: props at true real-world scale next to the product
composition.label_rule: logo and label face camera, upright, readable, undistorted
composition.palette: 2-3 dominant colours plus neutrals; product colour defines one of them
composition.thumbnail_test: product must still be clearly identifiable at 300x375 px

product_fidelity.rule: The product must be reproduced EXACTLY from the reference: same shape, proportions, colour, finish, logo, label text, packaging and number of items.
product_fidelity.preferred_mode: composite — cut out the real product, generate only the set around it, then relight edges and shadow to match
never: add or remove product parts or items
add a second copy of the product (except arrangement shot of set contents)

global_negative: heavy filters or colour grading on the product
